main.description: Gets custom emoji by record URI, across any number of repos and every supported emoji provider. URIs that name no emoji are left out.

uris.description: The emoji record URIs to get.

emojis.description: The emoji found, in the order their URIs were requested.

unreachable.description: Owners whose repo could not be read. Their emoji are left out of emojis, and asking again later can return them.
